scope: Inventory for the pinned gen-proto export. Fixtures are representative Go observations; Rust API codec implementations and complete wire parity belong to the API sprint.

mappings.contract: Preserve raw JSON semantics and invalid-input errors; no structural Rust DTO can replace this value. Error witnesses retain structured semantic/syntax context and exact underlying causes; intentionally variable top-level wording stays in captured stderr.
Custom MarshalJSONTo emits an empty responses array and conditionally emits the continuation token. Private pre-encoded response path remains an API-runtime fixture obligation.
Input union accepts a filename string or URI object. Fixture errors retain the pinned decoder's concrete Go type, structured location and exact underlying application reason.
Literal spellings are derived from typed constants by the pinned extractor.
Method identifiers are strings from Go constants; JSON export includes exact constant names and wire IDs.
Insertion order and nil slice values belong to the custom codec.

ordinaryFieldContract: Use exported Go shapes, original serialization tags, optional/nonnil flags, nullable result metadata and client visibility. TypeScript number spelling does not authorize lossy Rust f64 storage for integral IDs. These witnesses preserve zero/max IDs, empty omission and null; tags such as nonnil document upstream construction obligations and are not independently enforced by Go JSON.
